description:
Desktop proxy client powered by Xray core.

Happ is a application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.
• Improved connection startup and reliability on Windows
• Improved the connection engine with Xray 26.10.29
• Improved macOS menu bar icons for light and dark appearances
• Improved tooltip readability when increasing the interface scale
• Added a right-click editing menu to the Configuration field
• Added reconnect reminders when changing proxy or tunnel settings while connected
• Added Russian and Chinese translations for the routing data download message
• Fixed connection recovery after sleep, including unnecessary administrator password prompts on macOS
• Fixed connections being blocked during pending or failed routing data updates when existing files remain usable
• Fixed connections for some server links without a name
• Fixed endless loading when invalid text is entered as a subscription URL
• Fixed the Windows tray icon disappearing after Explorer restarts
• Fixed reopening the app from the macOS Dock when its window is hidden or minimized
